archetypes.name: dyn-ast-lint-precision
archetypes.rationale: New AST lints risk false positives on compliant gate and fence patterns
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the three new lint modules for false-positive risk on issue_create fence gating, plan_quality OR-combine/presentation softening, and unreachable-branch fallthrough facts. Confirm baselines shrink-only and required OptionalMetadata field coverage fails closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
